{{family name hatnote|Pomares|Ortega|lang=Spanish}}
'''Francisco Pomares Ortega''' (born 21 September 1998), sportingly known as '''Kiko''',<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.elchecf.es/noticias-futbolbase/equipo/ilicitano|title=Plantila (Elche Ilicitano)|trans-title=Squad (Elche Ilicitano)|publisher=Elche CF|language=Spanish|accessdate=22 March 2018|archive-date=10 May 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170510195606/http://www.elchecf.es/noticias-futbolbase/equipo/ilicitano|url-status=dead}}</ref> is an Andorran international [[association football|footballer]] who plays for [[CD Tarancón]] as a [[Defender (association football)#Full-back|left-back]].

Born in Spain, he qualifies to play for Andorra through his mother. His father is from [[Elche]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.diarioinformacion.com/elche-cf/2016/11/08/cuatro-canteranos-internacionales/1825498.html|title=Cuatro canteranos internacionales|publisher=Información|language=Spanish|date=8 November 2016|first=José Antonio|last=Galvañ|accessdate=22 March 2018}}</ref>

==International career==
Kiko Pomares played his first international game with the national team on 21 March 2018, in a friendly against [[Liechtenstein national football team|Liechtenstein]].<ref name="eu-foot">{{cite web | url=http://franjiverdes.com/kiko-pomares-del-ilicitano-debuta-con-la-seleccion-absoluta-de-andorra-con-victoria/ |title=Kiko Pomares, del Ilicitano, debuta con la selección absoluta de Andorra con victoria |publisher=Franjiverdes.com|first=Borja|last=Pastor|date=21 March 2018|accessdate=22 March 2018}}</ref>
